hypothesis_candidates.name: Massive_date_native_no_core_candidate_pool
hypothesis_candidates.baseline: cash-feasible core candidate or cash on the same decision date, with SPY and QQQ as secondary comparators
hypothesis_candidates.treatment: apply one frozen price/liquidity candidate policy to the date-native Massive as-of common-stock universe while removing legacy-core identity priority
hypothesis_candidates.replacement_value_comparator: actual displaced core candidate when present, otherwise cash; report SPY and QQQ separately
hypothesis_candidates.economic_mechanism: current-roster history omits later-delisted, acquired, renamed, and long-tail securities, which can bias opportunity counts and replacement ranking; date-native membership makes that opportunity set observable without survivor-only selection
hypothesis_candidates.falsifier: identity cannot be assigned uniquely at each decision date, executable touch density is below five per standard window, after-cost replacement value is nonpositive, fixed-window direction is unstable, or issuer/ticker concentration breaches the frozen guard
hypothesis_candidates.novelty_basis: new independent Massive date-native all-market source and first no-core candidate-pool use; not a threshold retune

hypothesis_candidates.name: flow_options_disagreement_downrank
hypothesis_candidates.treatment: bounded downrank only when forward Moomoo flow and options demand disagree
hypothesis_candidates.replacement_value_comparator: unmodified candidate, cash, SPY, QQQ, and displaced core
hypothesis_candidates.economic_mechanism: price continuation without confirming demand may be transient inventory transfer rather than durable sponsorship
hypothesis_candidates.falsifier: fewer than five touches per standard window or no positive replacement-value improvement

hypothesis_candidates.name: deterministic_intraday_reduce_risk
hypothesis_candidates.treatment: machine-default bounded REDUCE_RISK action under the frozen completed-close contract
hypothesis_candidates.replacement_value_comparator: hold unchanged versus reduced position after costs
hypothesis_candidates.economic_mechanism: late-session adverse information can remain under-reacted when an advisory action is not executed deterministically
hypothesis_candidates.falsifier: chronological halves do not both contain enough actions or net replacement value is nonpositive
